preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of edges m must be between 0 and the maximum possible number of edges in an undirected graph with n vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices and cannot connect a vertex to itself.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'FHTAGN!' if is_cthulhu(n, edges) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'FHTAGN!' if the graph represents Cthulhu, otherwise 'NO'.
